sentence: Shows a recap of what a group decided for an event: who is bringing each item, what is left for later, and one open question the group can vote on and settle.
use_when: Someone asks to recap what the group decided for a get-together
The group needs to see who is bringing what and what is still unclaimed
One open choice is left and people should vote on it
Members want to claim, release or tick off their own items
dont_use_when: The group needs a new poll from scratch with no plan around it
The request is for a shared calendar or picking a date and time
The group wants to split costs or track who owes money
